title: Abbas ki Bahen Hoon Koi Sonchta Nahi
body:
Abbas asws. ki behen hun koi sonchta nahi.
Hum aale mustafa hain koi bolta nahi.
1. Karbobala mein sham ke zindaa'n se aayi hun.
Poocho na kya kya daagh main dil par uthayi hun.
Kurta lahoo bhara hua pyase ka laayi hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Akbar asws. nahi hain Qasim o Asghar asws. nahi hai maa.
Bache hamare godh ke maqtal mein hai nihaa'n.
Maqtal ki sar zamee'n se main soughaat laayi hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hum aale mustafa saww. hai koi sonchta na tha.
Abbas asws. ki behen hun koi sonchta na tha.
Bazare Shaam me wo museebat uthayi hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bali Sakina s.a. Shaam ke zindaa'n mein reh gayi.
Poocho na kya kya daagh wo bibi bhi seh gayi.
Abid asws. ghareeb ko mai mere saath laayi hun..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Amma tumhari beti pe kya kya sitam hue.
Darbar mein yazeed l.a. ke hum nange sar hue.
Beti Ali asws. ki Fatima zehra s.a. ki jaayi hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bhayi ka daagh leke rasan basta aayi hain.
Amma tumhari laadli kufe se aayi hain.
Karbobala ke ban mein main basti basayi hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Matam yeh aaj anjuman e asghari ka hain.
Iqbal nauha pyas pe hai bekasi ka hai.
Bhayi ka nouha sunne main majlis mein aayi hun..
Kalaam: janab Iqbal abidi sahab.
